{{Top|leg}}
A '''holo-photo''' was a form of [[holograph]]ic image capture. Holo-photos were displayed in the [[Trophy Wall]] at [[Exovar's Emporium]], among other mementos of [[Luskin Exovar]]'s adventures. Visitors to the Emporium were also fond of taking holo-photos in front of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] head above the entrance to the establishment.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
